description: This file provides a data service module for a mechanic portal, handling local storage, and integration with Supabase for user authentication, request management, and profile handling. It includes functions for user registration, login, request creation, assignment, status updates, and utility functions for data normalization.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with an optional prefix.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON data from local storage with fallback.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Stringifies and writes JSON data to local storage.

methods.name: ensureSeedData
methods.description: Initializes local storage with seed data for users, requests, and fees if not already seeded.

methods.name: getSupabaseEnv
methods.description: Retrieves Supabase URL and key from environment variables.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfigured
methods.description: Checks if required Supabase environment variables are set.

methods.name: getSupabase
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client instance if environment variables are set.

methods.name: getLocalSession
methods.description: Retrieves session data from local storage.

methods.name: setLocalSession
methods.description: Stores session data in local storage.

methods.name: clearLocalSession
methods.description: Removes session data from local storage.

methods.name: getLocalUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users array from local storage.

methods.name: setLocalUsers
methods.description: Stores users array in local storage.

methods.name: getLocalRequests
methods.description: Retrieves requests array from local storage.

methods.name: setLocalRequests
methods.description: Stores requests array in local storage.

methods.name: normalizeVehicle
methods.description: Extracts and canonicalizes vehicle info from various database shapes.

methods.name: normalizeContact
methods.description: Extracts contact info from various database shapes.

methods.name: normalizeRequestRow
methods.description: Normalizes a raw request database row into a consistent object structure.

methods.name: supaGetUserRole
methods.description: Fetches user role and profile from Supabase profiles table.

methods.name: supaGetMechanicStatus
methods.description: Fetches mechanic approval status from Supabase profiles table.

methods.name: requireSupabaseUser
methods.description: Ensures a user is authenticated via Supabase.

methods.name: friendlySupabaseErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts Supabase error messages into user-friendly messages.
